name: Public Rental Housing
summary: Apply for a public rental flat. Waiting times are long, so apply early.
summary_zh: 申請公屋單位。輪候時間長，宜盡早申請。
who_for: Households under the income and asset limits
who_for_zh: 入息及資產低於限額的家庭

name: Transitional housing
organisation: Run by NGOs, funded by government
summary: Lower-rent homes for families waiting for public housing or living in subdivided flats.
summary_zh: 為輪候公屋或居於劏房的家庭提供較低租金的居所。
who_for: Families on the public housing waiting list

name: Rent allowance (CSSA)
summary: Help with rent for households on Comprehensive Social Security Assistance.
summary_zh: 為領取綜援的家庭提供租金津貼。
who_for: CSSA recipients

name: Urban hostels for single persons
summary: Short-term beds for people without a place to stay tonight. Call SWD to be referred.
summary_zh: 為今晚無處可住的人提供短期床位。可致電社署轉介。
who_for: Single adults with nowhere to sleep
who_for_zh: 無處棲身的單身成年人

name: Moving day volunteers
summary: Volunteers with a van help carry boxes and assemble furniture on a Saturday.
summary_zh: 義工於週六協助搬運及組裝傢俬。
who_for: Families moving into a new flat

name: Short-term Food Assistance
organisation_zh: 社署資助，社福機構營運
summary: Up to 8 weeks of food or food coupons while you get back on your feet.
summary_zh: 提供最多 8 星期的食物或食物券。
who_for: Low-income or recently unemployed households
who_for_zh: 低收入或剛失業的家庭

name: Food Angel hot meals
summary: Free hot meals at community centres across Hong Kong, cooked from rescued food.
summary_zh: 於各區社區中心派發免費熱飯。
who_for: Elderly, low-income families, anyone in need
who_for_zh: 長者、低收入家庭及有需要人士

name: People’s Food Bank
summary: Short-term food support for individuals and families facing sudden hardship.
summary_zh: 為突遇困境的人士及家庭提供短期食物支援。
who_for: Anyone facing a sudden drop in income

name: Sunday community lunch
organisation: A church in Sham Shui Po
summary: Sit down for a warm lunch after the 11am service. No need to attend the service.
summary_zh: 主日崇拜後一起吃午飯，不用參加崇拜也歡迎。
who_for: Everyone welcome

name: Meal train
summary: Friends take turns bringing dinner for a few weeks after a birth, surgery or loss.
summary_zh: 在生產、手術或喪親後，朋友輪流送晚飯幾星期。
who_for: Families going through a hard season
who_for_zh: 正經歷困難時期的家庭
keywords: new baby, baby, surgery, chemo, 初生嬰兒, 化療

name: Medical fee waiver
summary: Reduces or waives public hospital and clinic fees. Ask a medical social worker at the hospital.
summary_zh: 減免公立醫院及診所收費。可向醫院的醫務社工查詢。
who_for: Low-income patients and CSSA recipients
who_for_zh: 低收入病人及綜援受助人

name: Elderly Health Care Vouchers
summary: A yearly amount to spend at private doctors, dentists and optometrists.
summary_zh: 每年可用於私家醫生、牙醫及視光師的醫療券。
who_for: Residents aged 65 and over

name: District Health Centres
summary: Low-cost health checks, chronic disease support and rehab near where you live.
summary_zh: 在居住地區提供低收費健康檢查、慢性病支援及復康服務。
who_for: Any resident of the district

name: Hospital visitation team
summary: Trained volunteers visit patients, bring small comforts and pray if you want them to.
summary_zh: 受訓義工探望病人，如你願意亦會一起禱告。
who_for: Anyone in hospital and their family

name: Integrated Family Service Centres
summary: Social workers who help with family problems, parenting and finding the right service.
summary_zh: 社工協助處理家庭問題、親職及轉介合適服務。
who_for: Any family in Hong Kong

name: Comprehensive Social Security Assistance
name_zh: 綜合社會保障援助（綜援）
summary: Monthly financial support for households that cannot meet basic needs.
summary_zh: 為未能應付基本需要的家庭提供每月經濟援助。
who_for: Low-income households meeting residence rules
who_for_zh: 符合居港規定的低收入家庭

name: Working Family Allowance
organisation: Working Family and Student Financial Assistance Agency
organisation_zh: 在職家庭及學生資助事務處
summary: Extra monthly support for working families on low income, with more for children.
summary_zh: 為低收入在職家庭提供每月津貼，有兒童的家庭可獲更多。
who_for: Low-income working households

name: Family Crisis Support Centre
summary: 24-hour hotline and short-stay support for families in crisis.
summary_zh: 為面對危機的家庭提供 24 小時熱線及短期住宿支援。
who_for: Families facing conflict or crisis
who_for_zh: 面對衝突或危機的家庭

name: Harmony House hotline
summary: 24-hour support and refuge for people facing domestic violence.
summary_zh: 為面對家庭暴力人士提供 24 小時支援及庇護。
who_for: Anyone affected by domestic violence

name: Prayer line
summary: Leave a prayer request. A pastor or elder will pray for you this week, and call back if you want.
summary_zh: 留下代禱事項，牧者會在這星期為你禱告，如你願意亦會回電。
who_for: Anyone, whether or not you go to church
who_for_zh: 任何人，不論你有沒有返教會

name: Hospital chaplains
summary: Chaplains visit patients and families in public hospitals to listen and pray.
summary_zh: 院牧在公立醫院探訪病人及家屬，聆聽及禱告。
who_for: Patients and families in hospital

name: Find a church near you
summary: Churches near you with services in Cantonese, English or Mandarin, and who to ask for when you arrive.
summary_zh: 列出附近以粵語、英語或普通話崇拜的教會，以及到達時可找誰。
who_for: Anyone curious or looking for community
who_for_zh: 任何想認識信仰或尋找群體的人

name: Mental Health Support Hotline
summary: Talk to a trained person any time, day or night.
summary_zh: 日夜隨時與受訓人員傾訴。
who_for: Anyone feeling stressed, anxious or low
who_for_zh: 任何感到壓力、焦慮或情緒低落的人

name: Samaritan Befrienders Hong Kong
name_zh: 香港撒瑪利亞防止自殺會
summary: 24-hour emotional support and suicide prevention.
summary_zh: 24 小時情緒支援及防止自殺服務。
who_for: Anyone in distress

name: The Samaritans
summary: 24-hour listening in English, Cantonese and other languages.
summary_zh: 以英語、粵語及其他語言提供 24 小時聆聽服務。
who_for: Anyone in distress, including domestic helpers
who_for_zh: 任何受困擾的人，包括外籍家庭傭工

name: Shall We Talk
summary: Self-help tips and a directory of mental health services by age and need.
summary_zh: 自助貼士及按年齡和需要分類的精神健康服務名錄。
who_for: Anyone, and people caring for someone

name: Coffee and a listening ear
summary: Someone from your group meets you for coffee, no agenda. Just to listen.
summary_zh: 小組裏有人約你喝咖啡，沒有議程，只是聆聽。
who_for: Anyone carrying something heavy

name: Tsuen Wan family meal rota
summary: Volunteers cook and drop off dinners for two to four weeks after a birth, surgery or bereavement.
summary_zh: 義工在生產、手術或喪親後送晚飯兩至四星期。
who_for: Families in Tsuen Wan and Kwai Tsing
keywords: new baby, surgery, dinners, 送飯

name: Weekly elderly visiting team
summary: Pairs of volunteers visit older people who live alone once a week for a chat, small errands and a check-in.
summary_zh: 義工每星期兩人一組探訪獨居長者，傾偈、跑腿及關心近況。
who_for: Older people living alone and their families
keywords: elderly, lonely, visit, 探訪, 獨居
districts: Sham Shui Po, Yau Tsim Mong

name: Saturday moving crew
summary: A van and four volunteers help families move into public or transitional housing on Saturday mornings.
summary_zh: 一架貨車及四位義工在週六上午協助家庭搬入公屋或過渡性房屋。
who_for: Low-income families moving home
keywords: moving, boxes, public housing, 搬屋

name: After-school homework club
summary: Free homework help and a snack for P1 to S3 students on weekday afternoons, so working parents have cover.
summary_zh: 平日下午為小一至中三學生提供免費功課輔導及小食。
who_for: Children of working or single parents
who_for_zh: 雙職或單親家庭的子女

name: Carers’ coffee circle
summary: A monthly evening for people caring for a family member with dementia or long illness, with respite volunteers on hand.
summary_zh: 為照顧患認知障礙症或長期病患家人的照顧者而設的每月聚會，並有義工提供暫托。
who_for: Family carers

name: Rides to hospital appointments
summary: Volunteer drivers take older or disabled people to and from public hospital and clinic appointments.
summary_zh: 義工司機接送長者或殘疾人士往返公立醫院及診所覆診。
who_for: People who struggle to get to appointments

name: Neighbourhood food pantry
summary: Pick up rice, tins and fresh vegetables twice a week. No referral needed.
summary_zh: 每星期兩次領取白米、罐頭及新鮮蔬菜，毋須轉介。
who_for: Anyone short on food this week
who_for_zh: 本星期糧食不足的人士

name: Newcomers’ welcome lunch
summary: A monthly lunch after the English service for people new to Hong Kong, including domestic helpers on their day off.
summary_zh: 每月英文崇拜後為新來港人士而設的午餐，歡迎外籍家庭傭工假日參加。
who_for: People new to Hong Kong
